changelog: Media watched outside a channel now keeps its watch state even when that same title happens to be on air: a channel only covers the device it is playing on, so starting the title deliberately somewhere else records normally. Leaving a channel also stops holding back watch state for half a minute - the program is released three seconds after its playback actually stops, so watching it properly straight afterwards is recorded right away. A client that disappears without reporting a stop no longer keeps its program covered either, since the session ending releases it.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
